highlights.en: not every opportunity is an improvement.

Knowing when you
have enough is part of money management.

even on his first trade Michael took a profit at
the count and still came back for the bigger move when the market
repropagated.

a calendar system can work for a while, but only
because of a hidden reason in the market.

When the reason disappears, so
does the edge.

A fast 100% looks better than a slow
38% until you ask what the person was risking to get it.

Rank your last twenty trades by risk
taken, not by profit.

even professionals with every model and every
interview fall for one good trade.

anything you must watch all the time does not
belong to you; you belong to it.

when everything is on fire, the most valuable
person is the calm one who does the next useful thing.

mindmap.note_en: Gould refused a fund job because he already had a quiet office, a working method and time with his father.
mindmap.note_ar: رفض غولد العمل في صندوق لأن لديه مكتبًا هادئًا وطريقة ناجحة ووقتًا مع والده.

children.note_en: Not every opportunity is an improvement; knowing enough is money management.
children.note_ar: ليست كل فرصة تحسينًا؛ ومعرفة الكفاية جزء من إدارة المال.

children.note_en: Gould taught trading as a business and wrote World's Greatest Money Book.
children.note_ar: علّم غولد التداول كعمل تجاري وألّف كتابه عن المال.

mindmap.ar: الصفقة الأولى: هيا بنا يا أبي
mindmap.note_en: Michael's first silver trade in 1973 bought at $2.78, took profit at the Under count, re-entered at the Tipping Point.
mindmap.note_ar: أول صفقة فضة لـ Michael عام 1973: شراء عند 2.78، وربح عند الـ Under count، ثم إعادة الدخول عند الـ Tipping Point.

children.note_en: One contract off at about 3.30, Under re-established at 3.30, liquidated near $6.00.
children.note_ar: أُخذ عقد عند نحو 3.30 وأُعيد الـ Under عند 3.30 وصُفّي قرب 6.00.

children.note_en: Bank the Under, then let the structure invite you back in.
children.note_ar: اجنِ ربح الـ Under ثم دع البنية تدعوك للعودة.

mindmap.note_en: A five-dollar calendar system for silver worked for years because of year-end tax straddles.
mindmap.note_ar: نظام تقويم للفضة بخمسة دولارات نجح سنوات بسبب straddles الضريبية.

children.note_en: When the hidden reason disappears, so does the edge.
children.note_ar: إذا زال السبب الخفي زالت الميزة.

mindmap.note_en: Van Eck's three-trader contest: Kroll's fast 100% ended in a fund failure while Michael's slow 38% was sound.
mindmap.note_ar: منافسة Van Eck بين ثلاثة متداولين: ربح Kroll السريع انتهى بإغلاق الصندوق، وربح Michael البطيء كان سليمًا.

children.note_en: Kroll lost the first $50,000, got another, then lost 50% of a $1 million fund.
children.note_ar: خسر Kroll الـ 50,000 الأولى ثم أخرى ثم 50% من صندوق بمليون.

children.note_en: A fast 100% looks better than a slow 38% until you ask what was risked.
children.note_ar: يبدو 100% السريع أجمل حتى تسأل عن المخاطرة.

children.note_en: Rank your last twenty trades by risk taken, not profit.
children.note_ar: رتّب آخر عشرين صفقة بحسب المخاطرة لا الربح.

mindmap.note_en: Commodity Corporation's due diligence was forgotten after one big winning trade.
mindmap.note_ar: نُسي الـ due diligence في Commodity Corporation بعد صفقة رابحة كبيرة.

children.note_en: The private trader must set rules before excitement arrives.
children.note_ar: على المتداول وضع قواعده قبل أن تأتي الإثارة.

mindmap.note_en: Two stories: possessions you must watch own you, and Jim's calm in a crisis.
mindmap.note_ar: قصتان: ما تضطر لمراقبته يملكك، وهدوء Jim في الأزمة.

children.note_en: A position too big to stop thinking about is the same Ferrari.
children.note_ar: المركز الذي لا تكف عن التفكير فيه هو الـ Ferrari نفسها.

children.note_en: Jim walked over, handed the bag and asked if everyone was all right.
children.note_ar: جاء Jim ماشيًا وسلّم الكيس وسأل إن كان الجميع بخير.

children.note_en: When a market explodes against you, do the next useful thing.
children.note_ar: حين ينفجر السوق ضدك افعل الخطوة النافعة التالية.
